text: The Auditor General follows up on her reports to review management actions taken to implement the recommendations adopted by City Council and to ensure that intended benefits are being achieved. During this follow-up cycle, management reported 186 recommendations as fully implemented or no longer applicable. We selected 164 recommendations (96 for City divisions and 68 for various agencies and corporations) to review in this follow-up cycle. These included 117 high priority recommendations. The assessments for the 96 City division recommendations concluded that 61 are fully implemented, 1 is no longer applicable, and 34 are not fully implemented. The follow-up results for Toronto Parking Authority and Toronto Police Service were reported to their respective Boards in May 2026.
